title: Accept 30003822: A Grassmann proof of the Catalan divisor in the Teufl–Wagner forest transfer determinant
body:
## Accepted result and published preprint **A Grassmann proof of the Catalan divisor in the Teufl–Wagner forest transfer determinant**, Alec Kriebel. Published paper and verification package: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23430530 (https://zenodo.org/records/23430530).

Credited, self-contained proof exposition of the all-n integral Catalan divisor in the full Bell-partition Teufl–Wagner forest transfer determinant. Every input block uses one fixed arbitrary unweighted tree, and each admissible interlayer edge subset is counted once. The paired Grassmann forest algebra and Catalan quotient are established prior work; the exposition computes the induced determinant using ordered degree-triangular Gaussian factors and a constant rational kernel.

Alper Ferudun, Theorem 1.2, version 1.0, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23298482 (https://eulersolve.org/papers/owr-16164-020/), states the exact same all-n integral divisor with the same normalization. PR 1037 was created 2026-10-09T22:16:52Z (head commit 22:16:22Z); the matching DOI was registered 2026-10-11T13:01:38Z. Historical public visibility, independently evidenced discovery, intellectual priority and worldwide priority are unknown; no copying claim is made. The source review checked the matching core proof, but did not reproduce or validate its additional computer-assisted exactness claims.

Credits: Caracciolo–Jacobsen–Saleur–Sokal–Sportiello for the forest representation, Caracciolo–Sokal–Sportiello for forest/exponential/elimination identities, Sportiello Chapter 10 for the completed Catalan basis treatment, Kenyon–Wilson for the equivalent quotient/projection and tree pairing, and Di Francesco–Golinelli–Guitter for associated meander nonsingularity (not a premise of this proof). The official thesis catalogue year is 2010; its cover academic years are not a publication date.

Version 1.0, dated 13 October 2026, by Alec Kriebel (ORCID 0009-0001-9320-500X), independent researcher. Extensive AI assistance in solving, verification, source comparison and writing; unrefereed AI audits, with no human refereeing, journal acceptance or formal certification. The theorem asserts a divisor only: no exact multiplicity, quotient irreducibility, complete factorization, first-solution, new-method, new-basis or current-open-status claim. Li–Yan full-body overlap remains unknown; CSS 2017 and citation-chain/version comparisons remain partial. Authored text and code: CC BY 4.0. Frozen originals and fresh finite check evidence are distinguished. The supportkit records dated preparation checks and stage-specific AI reviews, each identified by scope and frozen inputs in REVIEW_HISTORY.json and EVIDENCE_INDEX.json. Those records are not human refereeing, journal acceptance, formal certification or submission/publication records.

## Accepted scope and review For all n>=1, the generic full Bell-partition forest transfer determinant over Z[a_ij] is divisible by (det A)^Catalan_n. No gap asserted for divisibility; exact multiplicity, residual-factor irreducibility and complete factorization not claimed. The result is accepted at the exact audited head `e87236a97c4b87818d2768cd5789043c7c3f4e39`. 2 fresh independent complete AI whole-package reviews were completed, with the final review finding zero actionable issues. Subsequent bounded administrative adoption is recorded in the current external ROOT final seal; earlier status/counter/hold fields remain dated history. Prior mathematical results and proof dependencies are credited. Historical novelty and worldwide current openness are unestablished. AI tools were used extensively; this is an unrefereed preprint, without conventional human peer review or formal proof certification. The repository Zenodo uploader verified the exact reviewed metadata and PDF/support bytes. The Google Workspace CLI recorded the DOI/details in the requested tracker with exact read-back. No GitHub release is created. Current audit and publication receipts: `audits/pr1037_30003822`.
Preserved original PR description: dated submission history ## Accepted scope This reconstructed theoretical edition proves the determinant-divisibility assertion in [Teufl–Wagner Problem 1](https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/46745), printed pp. 1457–1458, for every n ≥ 1: (det A)^C_n divides det T in Z[a_ij], for generic A and the full Bell-partition forest transfer matrix. It fixes one unweighted tree per input block and counts each admissible interlayer edge subset once. There is no planarity, noncrossing-state, symmetry, positivity or numerical nonzero-row-sum restriction. The conclusion is a divisor, not exact multiplicity of det A or irreducibility of the remaining factor. The full proof constructs the constant Catalan-dimensional quotient, determines its transfer determinant exactly, lifts through the invariant kernel, and uses Gauss's lemma for integer-polynomial divisibility. ## Evidence and review The complete 25,072-byte reconstructed proof and 14,983-byte fresh independent audit are included byte-for-byte. The audit accepts the exact present proof hash after checking all seven lemmas, normalization and signs, invariant spanning, ordered Gaussian factors, the constant kernel and integral descent. A separate full reading of the proof and audit also found no required mathematical change. This is a newly checked reconstructed edition of the same first approach, not byte-for-byte recovery certified by an old checksum and not a new substantive research turn. The full written audit retains its supplementary finite-check discussion; no checker code, standalone fixtures, execution-result files or logs are included. The all-n conclusion rests on the written argument. The forest algebra and Catalan/noncrossing quotient are established work of [Caracciolo–Sokal–Sportiello](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0706.1509v2) and [Sportiello’s thesis, Chapter 10](https://pcteserver.mi.infn.it/~caraccio/PhD/Sportiello.pdf). Attribution, the bounded related-work review, five freshly retrieved public PDF identities and inspection history are retained. No novelty, historical-priority or current-open-status claim is made. The reviews are AI mathematical/source audits, not human peer review or formal proof-assistant verification. ## Exact addition-only scope Add exactly ten files under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30003822/`: the full proof, full fresh audit, attribution, acceptance, status and provenance, source catalogue/inspection metadata, README and noncircular manifest. No QUEUE.md or unrelated file changes. No copied third-party source PDFs, text, HTML or images, dataset contents, private sources, derived source-text fingerprints, private inventories or private coordination material are included.
